parent: coalesced-v3 direct-grid kernel; no persistent-v2 or padding-rejection combination
mechanism: K64 grouping of four otherwise identical K16 operations. This reduces synchronization frequency, not true cross-iteration double buffering.
one_mechanism_boundary: Four shared-B slices and four distinct register-A fragments are required to retain operands until grouped completion
One inline-PTX region encloses four same-shape operations and commit/wait to constrain asynchronous register lifetimes
No new packed layout, routing, grid policy, outputzeroing, precision, epilogue fusion or model behavior
algorithm: For each baseK0,64,...4032, stage four8x16 BF16 activation slices
Preserve producer CTA barrier, async proxy fence and second CTA barrier
Decode four coalesced FP4/group16scale register fragments with unchanged v3 expressions
Fence registers, issue four ascendingK16 operations on the same FP32 accumulator tile
Only first operation atK0 uses zero accumulator; every subsequent operation accumulates
Commit one WGMMA group and wait0 once, then CTA barrier before overwriting any shared slice

invariants.K: Host retains K4096 requirement, divisible64; CPU coverage equals exactly0..4095
invariants.shared_layout: Four independent BMap slices each256bytes, each128-byte aligned; descriptors created from actual slice pointers
invariants.register_lifetime: All four decoded register-A fragments retained until common wait; no ordinary accumulator access between GMMA issues and wait
invariants.convergence: Existing expert guards remain CTA-uniform; all128 threads execute matching warpgroup and CTA synchronization
invariants.numerics: Same instruction shape, ascendingK16 sequence, BF16 dequant products and FP32 accumulator. Intended equivalence requires official GPU oracle; CPUcompile does not prove numerical agreement.

source_and_SASS_counts_per_active_CTA_K4.candidate_SASS_loop: Four HGMMA, one WARPGROUP.DEPBAR, three BAR.SYNC; no local load/store instructions observed
